summary: This script defines a collection of shell functions for console output utilities—printing colored text in cyan and red, displaying errors, asking yes-or-no questions, and showing banners. The functions are declared but not implemented (their bodies are empty), so this appears to be a template or interface file that other scripts would source to get these utility functions.

explanations.1: This line tells the system to use the bash interpreter from wherever it's installed in the environment, rather than assuming a fixed location—makes the script more portable across different systems.
explanations.3: The 'function' keyword declares a reusable block of code named console::printCyan that can be called later; the double colon is a naming convention to group related functions under a 'console' namespace.
